category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, increase hidden width from 64 to 96 and reduce learning rate from 1e-3 to 8e-4. Greater capacity may improve item discrimination, while smaller updates stabilize the wider network. Retain two blocks, two heads, 2× feed-forward expansion and dropout 0.2. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor construction propagate the new width consistently; masked-target training, appended-mask inference and one model per category remain unchanged.

change_summary: Jointly tune BERT4Rec hidden width to 96 and learning rate to 8e-4 for all four category models, using existing metadata-driven predictor dimensions.
